headline: Callahan's Passage Breaches As Northern Front Clashes Intensify
war_summary: Callahan’s Passage has cracked open following hours of bitter attrition, with Colonials wresting Crumbling Post from Warden control amidst over eleven hundred casualties in the past two hours alone. Fighting across Weathered Expanse shows no sign of abating, adding four fresh base transitions in the latest interval as contested strongholds like Crow’s Nest and Frostmarch continue to change hands in rapid succession. Meanwhile, the violent ground offensive in Palantine Berm has paused base exchanges despite casualty rates accelerating sharply over the last hour. Across the northwestern theatre, Mooring County remains an unrelenting meat-grinder, devouring hundreds of infantrymen per hour without yielding territory, whereas the engagement along Nevish Line has cooled substantially after yesterday's heavy bloodletting. Stlican Shelf and the southern sectors remain quiet, leaving Callahan’s Passage and Weathered Expanse as the primary cauldrons driving the shifting frontline.
